labels.id: 🔴 Bahaya Sangat Tinggi, ukur ulang segera

recommendations.zh: 休息 1–5 分鐘重測；若持續，請立刻就醫或聯絡醫師。
recommendations.id: Istirahat 1–5 menit lalu ukur ulang; jika tetap tinggi, segera ke dokter atau hubungi dokter.
recommendations.en: Rest for 1–5 minutes and measure again; if it remains high, seek care or contact your doctor immediately.

recommendations.zh: 10 分鐘內重測；確認是否漏藥；今日內回報醫師。
recommendations.id: Ukur ulang dalam 10 menit; periksa apakah lupa minum obat; laporkan ke dokter hari ini.
recommendations.en: Measure again within 10 minutes, check for a missed dose, and report it to your doctor today.

recommendations.id: Cukup catat saja, tidak perlu alarm.
recommendations.en: Record it; no alert is needed.

recommendations.zh: 跌倒高風險區。立刻重測；若有頭暈、混亂、快昏倒等症狀，聯絡醫師。
recommendations.id: Zona risiko tinggi jatuh. Segera ukur ulang; jika pusing, linglung, atau lemas mau pingsan, segera hubungi dokter.
recommendations.en: This is a high fall-risk range. Measure again immediately; contact your doctor if you feel dizzy, confused, or close to fainting.

recommendations.zh: 需坐下或躺下休息，5-10 分鐘後重測，並詢問是否有頭暈、冒冷汗。
recommendations.id: Istirahat duduk or berbaring, ukur ulang setelah 5-10 menit, dan tanyakan apakah pusing atau keringat dingin.
recommendations.en: Sit or lie down to rest, measure again after 5–10 minutes, and check for dizziness or cold sweats.

recommendations.zh: 舒張壓稍低但無礙，此區間不拉警報 🚦，避免狼來了效應。
recommendations.id: Diastolik agak rendah tapi aman, area ini tidak memicu alarm 🚦 untuk menghindari alarm fatigue.
recommendations.en: Diastolic pressure is slightly low but safe; this range does not trigger an alert 🚦 to avoid alarm fatigue.

recommendations.id: Agak rendah tapi masih dalam batas aman.
recommendations.en: Slightly low but still within a safe range.

recommendations.id: Rentang tekanan darah ideal yang stabil.
recommendations.en: An ideal, stable blood pressure range.

recommendations.id: Rentang tekanan darah ideal yang stabil.
recommendations.en: An ideal, stable blood pressure range.

recommendations.zh: 落在醫師設定的目標區間內，維持目前作息與用藥即可。
recommendations.id: Berada dalam rentang target yang ditetapkan dokter; lanjutkan rutinitas dan obat seperti biasa.
recommendations.en: Within the target range set by the doctor; keep the current routine and medication.

recommendations.zh: 高於醫師設定的目標區間。記錄下來，回診或聯絡醫師時一併回報。
recommendations.id: Di atas rentang target dokter. Catat dan laporkan saat kontrol atau saat menghubungi dokter.
recommendations.en: Above the doctor's target range. Record it and report it at the next visit or when contacting the doctor.

recommendations.zh: 低於醫師設定的目標區間。起身放慢、留意頭暈與跌倒，回診時一併回報。
recommendations.id: Di bawah rentang target dokter. Bangun perlahan, waspadai pusing dan risiko jatuh, dan laporkan saat kontrol.
recommendations.en: Below the doctor's target range. Stand up slowly, watch for dizziness and falls, and report it at the next visit.

recommendations.zh: 舒張壓低於一般參考下限 60。記錄下來、回診時帶給醫師看；若同時頭暈或站起來發黑，請先坐下休息。
recommendations.id: Diastolik di bawah batas rujukan umum 60. Catat dan tunjukkan ke dokter saat kontrol; jika disertai pusing atau pandangan gelap saat berdiri, duduklah dulu.
recommendations.en: Diastolic pressure is below the usual reference floor of 60. Record it and show it to the doctor at the next visit; sit down first if it comes with dizziness or greying out on standing.
